page.layout: One printed page: running head and page number at the top, then one column of short glossed Greek verb entries, with a small mark at the lower right.

main_text.p: 2. Formantia item ex sese defectivū in ἐννύω vel ἔσχω: ut ἀμφιεννύω induo, ἀμφιέω, ab ἀμφιέω: ἀρέσκω placeo, ἀρέσω, ab ἀρέω.
3. Quædam tamen habent ε & η promiscuè: ut αἰνέω laudo, αἰνέω vel αἰνῶ: sic φέω φέω timeo: & ξηρέω perforo. sic δέω ligo.

page.notes: The Greek is copied as far as legible; accents and breathings in the verb forms are uncertain at several points and are marked [?] where doubtful. The mark at the lower right ("760-" or similar, in small type) is unclear and is given as [?] in the signature, not as text. The running head "P. RAMI" is in small capitals. No marginal notes are printed.
